in_sanskrit.name: Athdeep
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Deep, vast, infinite
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Athdeep एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Athdeep is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ath' meaning 'beyond' and 'deep' meaning 'deep, vast, infinite'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the god Vishnu, representing the infinite and beyond.
